about: CC-fancy-0012 sheet selection + rows view, and CC-fancy-0013 read limits. Read by all three ports; every expectation is written by hand. Options are PHP's: read(bytes, {sheet, limits}) and rows(sheet, {formulas, maxCells}).

read.name: defaults read every sheet
sheet selects one sheet by name
